title: Unicorn Attack!!!🦄
transcript: We're going to start by bringing out one of our knights. Pretty much no matter what black does, we are going to play h3. The opening that I'm about to show you, by the way, is a system, so you can play it with either color and pretty much against every single thing that your opponent is going to throw at you. Here it's where it gets interesting. We are going to place this knight on h2. I know, I know, I can see the evaluation bar dropping, but let me tell you, I have played about 20 games in the new opening and I have been playing against players all over 2000 and I have won over half of the games without even knowing any theory whatsoever. Now, we want to bring out the other knight, but if we do it right away, we're going to get kicked. So, we have to start with pawn to a3. We can play knight to c3 and again, pretty much no matter what they do, we can just pre-move [music] knight to a2. And now, we conclude this beautiful structure and this is what inspired the name of this opening. The name of the new system that I just created is the unicorn attack because [laughter] these pawns standing over the knights kind of look like horns. So, they become unicorns. This is it. This is the entry point of the unicorn attack and I have some games ready to show you as demonstration of how a unicorn attack game can be developed. I was playing against a 2016. This is a blitz game. So, a very serious player. I bring out the other knight and now after e5, we achieve the starting point of the unicorn attack with our two unicorns. e6, I take, he takes in the center and now I kick away the knight. He takes en passant, my bishop comes out and after castles and castles, the position is back to equality. My knights are going to find a new life and that's exactly what I do here. We're basically trying to bait white into taking this knight and opening up a rook. But here white takes the knight. I'm happy to get a bishop for the knight and all of a sudden we are slightly better here. Immediately I did blunder because after queen to D3, we're actually losing material. Takes, takes, and both these and this are under attack. Of course fools will resign and I noticed that the king is very open here. So maybe we can try to make some attack going on and prepare a little trap. I am hoping that he brings the rook to the center which seems like a very logical move and he does but this is losing because of rook takes, rook takes, bishop takes and after he opens up like this, I would have won the rook here with check. But now I can take here and actually I'm threatening checkmate in one and I went on to win this game pretty smoothly from here. And now I pass it on to you. I want you guys to test the unicorn opening in your own games and send me some of your games. I hope you're going to have fun with the unicorn attack. Let me know how it goes.
